versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated: the wrapper script for post-push CI/CD monitoring was removed, and instructions now focus solely on the git alias method.
- No changes to the skill's functionality or code.

- Added detailed usage instructions for integrating GitHub CLI (`gh`) and GitLab CLI (`glab`) commands to monitor pipeline status after pushes.
- Provided a sample custom `git-pushflow` script and installation steps to automate post-push pipeline monitoring.
- Included a Git alias alternative in `.gitconfig` for easy use of the push-and-monitor workflow.
- Streamlined and consolidated feature descriptions for clarity and ease of reference.

- Updated skill description to emphasize CI/CD pipeline monitoring and Auto DevOps focus.
- Added a playful tagline: "Auto DevOps this is the way 🦞!" to the description.

- Added a YAML frontmatter section with the skill name and description to SKILL.md for improved metadata.
- No changes to functionality or code; documentation enhancement only.

Initial release of GitFlow, automating code pushes and CI/CD status monitoring for GitHub and GitLab.

- Automatic pushing of local commits to remote repositories.
- Real-time monitoring and unified reporting for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
- Multi-repository support with minimal setup required.
- Instant notifications on pipeline status, including build success or failure and direct access to logs.
